result.boundary: Original Villa contains no enabled Nanite meshes. The compatibility package deliberately converts a separate project copy. Real component disable flags, all-hidden candidates, non-Nanite mesh replacement, and restoration are tested. Empty visible Nanite work now exits before raster visibility/depth preparation. The scene opt-in still initializes streaming infrastructure and enables conservative ordinary-occlusion invalidation; zero total CPU/memory overhead is not claimed. These instrumented frozen-clock checks are correctness evidence and do not establish Nanite-on scene performance acceptance.
